contents.typescript.tsdk.desc:
Menentukan folder path to the tsserver dan `lib*.d.ts` berkas under a TypeScript pasang to use untuk IntelliSense, untuk example: `./node_modules/typescript/lib`.

- When specified as a user pengaturan, the TypeScript version dari `js/ts.tsdk.path` automatically replaces the built-in TypeScript version.
- When specified as a ruang kerja pengaturan, `js/ts.tsdk.path` allows you to switch to use that ruang kerja version of TypeScript untuk IntelliSense dengan the `TypeScript: Select TypeScript version` command.

See the [TypeScript documentation](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/typescript/typescript-compiling#_using-newer-typescript-versions) untuk more detail about mengelola TypeScript versions.

contents.configuration.tsserver.watchOptions.watc: Strategy untuk how individual berkas are watched.
Polls berkas in chunks at regular interval.
Check every berkas untuk changes several times a second at a fixed interval.
Check every berkas untuk changes several times a second, but use heuristics to check certain types of berkas less frequently than others.
Use a dynamic queue where less-frequently modified berkas will be checked less often.
Attempt to use the operating system/berkas system's native events untuk berkas changes.

Strategy untuk how entire direktori trees are watched under systems that lack recursive berkas-watching functionality.
Polls direktori in chunks at regular interval.
Check every direktori untuk changes several times a second at a fixed interval.
Use a dynamic queue where less-frequently modified direktori will be checked less often.
Attempt to use the operating system/berkas system's native events untuk direktori changes.

Named imports are sorted oleh name only. E.g. `import { type A, B, type Y, Z } from 'module';`
Ketik only named imports are sorted untuk the beginning of the import list. E.g. `import { type A, type Y, B, Z } from 'module';`
contents.typescript.preferences.organizeImports.u: Specify whether to sort imports using Unicode atau Ordinal collation.
Sort imports using the numeric value of each code point.
Sort imports using the Unicode code collation.
contents.typescript.preferences.organizeImports.l: Requires `organizeImports.unicodeCollation: 'unicode'`. Overrides the locale used untuk collation. Specify `auto` to use the UI locale.
contents.typescript.preferences.organizeImports.c: Requires `organizeImports.unicodeCollation: 'unicode'`, dan `organizeImports.caseSensitivity` is not `caseInsensitive`. Indicates whether upper-case will sort before lower-case.
Lower-case comes before upper-case. E.g.` a, A, z, Z`.
Upper-case comes before lower-case. E.g. ` A, a, B, b`.
contents.typescript.preferences.organizeImports.n: Requires `organizeImports.unicodeCollation: 'unicode'`. Sort numeric strings oleh integer value.
contents.typescript.preferences.organizeImports.a: Requires `organizeImports.unicodeCollation: 'unicode'`. Compare characters dengan diacritical marks as unequal to base character.

contents.walkthroughs.nodejsWelcome.title: Get dimulai dengan JavaScript dan Node.js
contents.walkthroughs.nodejsWelcome.description: Make the most of Visual Studio Code's first-class JavaScript experience.
Node.js is an easy way to jalankan JavaScript code. You can use it to quickly build command-line apps dan servers. It also comes dengan npm, a package manager which makes reusing dan sharing JavaScript code easy.
[Install Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en/download/)

Node.js is an easy way to jalankan JavaScript code. You can use it to quickly build command-line apps dan servers. It also comes dengan npm, a package manager which makes reusing dan sharing JavaScript code easy.
[Install Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en/download/package-manager/)
contents.walkthroughs.nodejsWelcome.makeJsFile.de:
Let's write our first JavaScript berkas. We'll have to buat a new berkas dan simpan it dengan the ``.js`` ekstensi at the end of the berkas name.
[Create a JavaScript File](command:javascript-walkthrough.commands.createJsFile)
contents.walkthroughs.nodejsWelcome.debugJsFile.d:
Once you've terpasang Node.js, you can jalankan JavaScript programs at a terminal oleh entering ``node your-file-name.js``
Another easy way to jalankan Node.js programs is oleh using VS Code's debugger which lets you jalankan your code, pause at different points, dan help you understand what's going on step-oleh-step.
[Start Debugging](command:javascript-walkthrough.commands.debugJsFile)
contents.walkthroughs.nodejsWelcome.debugJsFile.a: Debug dan jalankan your JavaScript code in Node.js dengan Visual Studio Code.
